subtitleCaption.rootCause: play() laid text out for the full line before _switchFrame() repositioned the frame back to y=460, so the lift was lost.
subtitleCaption.fix: _switchFrame() re-runs _layoutFont(); speaker ink target moved from frameTop+14 to +26.

assistantDrag.rootCause: clamp() stopped at 10px, and init() clamped with the expanded 440x610 box before collapse() persisted the collapsed position.
assistantDrag.fix: top clamp allows 0; collapsed class applied before first clamp; html.ia-dragging disables the window drag handle; endDrag() saves on pointerup/cancel/lostpointercapture.
assistantDrag.verification: tmp/test-assistant.cjs: drag to top (y=0), drag back, drag elsewhere, reload keeps position.
